plugin.name: Venture AI Lawyer Desk
plugin.description: For partner lawyers: clients draft with Venture AI on the site, then ask a licensed lawyer from any firm to review. Here you see the facts, red flags and versions, talk with the client, schedule calls, edit in Word and finalise. Silicon Valley and Taipei.
view.main.name: Venture AI Lawyer Desk
panel.subtitle: Every visitor, what they need, and who will follow up.
panel.connect.title: Connect the intake service
panel.connect.desc: Enter the portal token from your intake service once. AI WorkDeck keeps it securely; it is never shown in this panel.
panel.error.load: The intake service could not be reached. Please check the network or the connection, then try again.
panel.error.upgrade: This version of AI WorkDeck doesn't support plugin connections yet. Please update the app.
panel.error.action: That did not go through. Please try again.
panel.empty.title: No enquiries yet
panel.empty.desc: Display the QR code at your booth. Each visitor appears here the moment they leave their details.
panel.select: Select an enquiry to see the brief, the visitor's answers and the conversation.
panel.qr.title: Booth QR code
panel.qr.desc: Visitors scan this code to open the intake page. For print, allow at least 6 cm in width.
panel.toast.handed: Sent to the AI assistant in this project
panel.error.ai: The AI request did not go through: {reason}
panel.m.subtitle: Venture AI drafts with the client; you review, decide and finalise.
panel.m.empty.title: No matters yet
panel.m.empty.desc: When a client asks for review, the matter arrives here with the draft, the facts and the whole conversation.
panel.m.section.notes: Venture AI's notes to the client
panel.m.msg.title: Message to the client
panel.m.msg.desc: The client sees this in their conversation, under your name. Use it for questions, the engagement terms or a call time.
panel.m.call.title: Schedule a call
panel.m.call.desc: Adds the call to this project's calendar in AI WorkDeck and tells the client the time.
panel.m.call.tell: Tell the client the proposed time
panel.m.conflict.title: Conflict check
panel.m.conflict.none: No conflicts found in the firm's records for: {names}
panel.m.conflict.hits: Possible conflicts found. Review before proceeding:
panel.m.conflict.unavailable: Your firm's conflict records are not available in this AI WorkDeck (law-firm management is not set up). Run the check in the firm's usual system, then tick the box when signing off.
panel.m.edit.title: Edit the document
panel.m.edit.desc: Saving creates a new version under your name. The client sees it in their conversation.
panel.m.edit.note: What you changed (shown to the client)
panel.m.import.title: Import an edited file
panel.m.import.desc: Choose the Word or text file you edited in this project. It becomes the next version.
panel.m.import.none: No Word or text files in this project yet. Choose Edit in AI WorkDeck and the document is put into the project.
panel.m.sign.title: Finalise version {n}
panel.m.sign.desc: The client receives this version as final, with your review line on the PDF and Word file.
panel.m.sign.name: Your name
panel.m.sign.c1: Conflicts are cleared for every party named in this matter.
panel.m.sign.c2: Scope and fee are agreed with the client and the engagement is confirmed.
panel.m.sign.c3: I have reviewed this version in full and approve it for delivery.
panel.m.sign.done: Finalised. The client can now download the final document.
panel.m.notify.title: Review requested: {doc}
panel.m.notify.body: {client} asked for a lawyer to review and finalise. {call}
panel.m.err.version: The document changed while you were finalising. Please review the latest version.
panel.m.err.calendar: The calendar could not be updated: {reason}
panel.m.err.file: That file could not be read: {reason}
panel.m.budget.low: Venture AI budget: {left} of {limit} left. Raise the cap before it runs out; below $1, clients are asked to come back later.
panel.m.title: Venture AI Lawyer Desk
panel.m.consult.title: Call request
panel.m.err.consult: The call was added to the calendar, but its status could not be updated ({reason}).
panel.m.event.consult_requested: Client asked for a call with a lawyer
panel.m.questions.lede: Points Venture AI and the client could not settle; the client asked for them to be decided in the review.
panel.m.office.label: Office
panel.m.accept.title: Accept matter
panel.m.accept.client: Save "{name}" to the firm's client ledger
panel.m.accept.file: File the matter: create the matter project
panel.m.native.title: Firm records
panel.m.err.noProject: Accept and file the matter first
panel.m.file.name: {title} · Version {n}
panel.m.awd.editing: Editing in AI WorkDeck: {name}. When you're done, choose Save as new version.
panel.m.awd.accept.title: Accept the matter first
panel.m.awd.accept.desc: Once you accept and file the matter, AI WorkDeck creates its matter project. The document goes into that project and opens in AI WorkDeck's editor.
panel.m.awd.pending.title: No matter project yet
panel.m.awd.pending.desc: The filing is waiting for conflict clearance. Once it clears, the matter project is created and you can edit the document in AI WorkDeck.
panel.m.save.title: Save as new version
panel.m.save.desc: Reads “{name}” as you edited it in AI WorkDeck and saves it as version {n} under your name. The client sees it in their conversation.
panel.m.save.stale: You edited version {base}; version {latest} has arrived since. Your file becomes version {n}, without the changes in version {latest}.
panel.m.err.unchanged: The file still reads like version {n}. If you just edited it, wait a few seconds for the editor to save, then try again.
panel.m.err.gone: “{name}” is no longer in the project. Choose Edit in AI WorkDeck again.
panel.m.err.tool: AI WorkDeck could not handle the file: {reason}
